title: FullFront: Benchmarking MLLMs Across the Full Front-End Engineering Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2505.17399v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Front-end engineering involves a complex workflow where engineers conceptualize designs, translate them into code, and iteratively refine the implementation. While recent benchmarks primarily focus on converting visual designs to code, we present FullFront, a benchmark designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) \textbf{across the full front-end development pipeline}. FullFront assesses three fundamental tasks that map directly to the front-end engineering pipeline: Webpage Design (conceptualization phase), Webpage Perception QA (comprehension of visual organization and elements), and Webpage Code Generation (implementation phase). Unlike existing benchmarks that use either scraped websites with bloated code or oversimplified LLM-generated HTML, FullFront employs a novel, two-stage process to transform real-world webpages into clean, standardized HTML while maintaining diverse visual designs and avoiding copyright i

translated_title: FullFront：面向前端工程全流程的多模态大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 前端工程涉及一个复杂的工作流程，工程师需要将设计概念化、将其转化为代码，并迭代地完善实现。虽然近期的基准测试主要集中于将视觉设计转换为代码，我们提出了FullFront，这是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在整个前端开发流程中能力的基准测试。FullFront评估三项直接对应前端工程流程的基本任务：网页设计（概念化阶段）、网页感知问答（对视觉组织与元素的理解）以及网页代码生成（实现阶段）。与现有基准测试使用代码臃肿的爬取网站或过度简化的LLM生成HTML不同，FullFront采用了一种新颖的两阶段流程，将真实世界的网页转换为干净、标准化的HTML，同时保持多样化的视觉设计并避免版权问题。
tldr: FullFront是一个新的基准测试，通过网页设计、网页感知问答和网页代码生成三项任务，全面评估多模态大语言模型在前端工程全流程中的能力。
en_tdlr: FullFront is a new benchmark that evaluates Multimodal Large Language Models across the full front-end engineering pipeline through three tasks: Webpage Design, Webpage Perception QA, and Webpage Code Generation.
